scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof supplemented by exact finite checking for 899 moduli; numerical examples are evidence not a proof. No claim of external certification or peer review.
scientific_limitations: Classifies finite-modulus consecutive cyclic blocks only, not arbitrary nonconsecutive offsets or asymptotics in growing moduli. The squarefree branch is covered by the classical Schemmel totient; the distinction of even-valued p-adic gcd exponents is the new subject. A historical priority search cannot guarantee uniqueness, and the Costello-Watts withdrawn paper was inspected at abstract level only.
title: Exact cyclic run-length spectrum of square-gcd totatives
